title.label: Way better than any other I’ve used

content.label:
I thought this would just be another voice to text app until I tried it. The accuracy is amazing and the way it formats things without you telling it to is so helpful. I love how you can make a correction while you’re talking and it types only the corrected part and takes out all the parts you don’t want in the typing anyway. I can voice type with about 99% accuracy and twice as fast as I can type manually.

I have a YouTube channel with 350,000 subscribers, and I do a lot of typing, so this really helps
